_comment: Everything in this watcher that is about bicycles rather than about finding a stolen thing. Generated from the constants the repo ran on from 2026-09-05; tests/test_pack_parity.py asserts it still matches. Copy this file to add an object class.

positives: a photo of a bicycle with drop handlebars, a road or gravel bike
negatives: a photo of a mountain bike with flat handlebars
a photo of a city or hybrid bicycle with flat straight handlebars
a photo of an electric bicycle with a motor
a photo of a folding bicycle
a photo of a small child's bicycle
a photo of a BMX bicycle
a photo of a bicycle wheel or spare part, not a whole bicycle

positives: a photo of a bicycle with a slim steel tube frame, classic touring style
negatives: a photo of a modern carbon fibre aero racing bicycle
a photo of a thick aluminium frame bicycle

positives: a photo of a bicycle with a child seat mounted on the back
negatives: a photo of a bicycle with no accessories

navy._comment: Measured off the raw pixels, not asked of CLIP: CLIP's colour answers were noise (median 0.37 on 'tan sidewalls'). Hue in degrees. Backgrounds pollute it, which is why it is an OR arm and never a filter on its own.

prompt._comment: Assembled as: intro / label_line / the item's own description / scoring + bands / closing. Two parts are load-bearing and each was paid for with a failed run: the bands must SPAN the range -- a 'Be strict' instruction collapsed 116 of 120 scores to exactly 0, including all three reference photos -- and the item description must warn about any background colour in the reference photos, or the model credits the wall.
prompt.intro:
You are helping find ONE specific stolen bicycle in marketplace photos.
Reference photos of it are attached first — study them before judging.
prompt.scoring: Score how plausibly the photo could be THIS bike, 0-10:
prompt.bands:
0-1  wrong genre entirely — mtb, e-bike, city/hybrid, kids, BMX, folding,
      a spare part, a frame only, or not a bicycle
 2-3  a drop-bar bike, but clearly a different one (modern sloping-top-tube
      carbon race bike, or plainly the wrong colour)
 4-5  right genre — a steel or steel-looking drop-bar gravel/touring/cross
      bike — but nothing specific lines up
 6-7  several specific features line up: e.g. dark blue AND drop bars, or a
      level top tube on a steel drop-bar bike, or gumwall tyres plus racks
 8-10 could really be it: frame shape and colour both match, or the kit
      (child seat, twin racks, gumwalls) is recognisable
prompt.closing:
Use the whole range. Judge what you can actually see; if the photo is too
small, dark or cropped to tell, say so in the reason and score the middle.

_comment_secondary: sweep_queries is the Wallapop national newest-first feed, which is shallow and needs depth; sweep_queries_secondary is Milanuncios, which is distance-filtered server-side and reaches back a day on two pages.
_comment_gate_arms: The arms the pre-gate is allowed to use. Arms outside this list still score and still rank the digest, but never decide whether a photo is paid for -- 'steel' on the bicycle pack is a tie-breaker and far too noisy to gate on (it reads 0.81 on a dim photo of the bike's own drive side).
